I carried an extra 120 1bs on my body every single day. And when you’ve struggled with obesity your whole life, you don’t always realize just how heavy life has become. You just learn to live with it. I was the bigger girl for most of my life. I tried d1ets, restricti0n, starting over every Monday and telling myself I just needed more willpower. But losing 120  taught me something I wish I’d understood years ago: Obesity wasn’t a character flaw. And I didn’t have to keep doing it the hardest way. Finding the right tools—including G✅P1s—changed what was possible for me. Now I can literally pick up 120, drop it, and think… I used to carry THIS everywhere I went. 😳 If you’ve struggled with your w8 your whole life and feel like you’ve tried everything, you’re exactly who I created this page for. ❤️ DM me START if you want to know what finally worked for me. 💌 #foryoupage #Obesity #transformation #obesitymedicine #WomenOver40
